literal_meaning: তিনটি কুল বা বংশ: পিতৃকুল, মাতৃকুল এবং শ্বশুরকুল
figurative_meaning_en: paternal family, maternal family, and in-laws' family
similar_in_english: No direct equivalent; akin to 'extended family on all sides'
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সকলকে খেয়ে বসে আছে, ত্রিকুলের তার আর কেউ নেই।
তার ত্রিকুলের সম্পত্তি সব নষ্ট হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has devoured everyone; there's no one left in his three families.
All the property from his three families has been ruined.
note: Refers to the traditional Bengali joint family system encompassing both birth families and marital ties.
